steps.detail: Explain the emergency and ask for an exception while the booking is still active — no-shows are far harder to refund.
Airlines assess genuineness: expect to provide medical documents showing the emergency, as Air India requested in this case.
A written request through the airline's official channels creates a record; keep the PNR and all replies.
Under India's revised DGCA norms, cancellation for your own or a co-traveller's medical emergency makes you eligible for a refund or credit shell — cite it if the first answer is no.
